injuries.name: AJ Barner
injuries.short_comment: Barner caught one of three targets for 12 yards during Sunday's 30-23 win over the Chargers.

injuries.name: Zach Charbonnet
injuries.short_comment: Seahawks head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Charbonnet (knee) won't be activated from the reserve/PUP list in advance of Sunday's game against the 49ers, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune

injuries.name: Jason Myers
injuries.short_comment: Myers made his only field-goal try and went 3-for-4 on extra-point attempts during Sunday's 30-23 win against the Chargers.

injuries.name: Rashid Shaheed
injuries.short_comment: Shaheed caught one of three targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 30-23 win over the Chargers. He added two carries for 33 yards and a touchdown.

injuries.name: Cade Otton
injuries.short_comment: Otton caught three of four targets for 25 yards in a 24-16 win over Dallas on Thursday.

injuries.name: Jalon Daniels
injuries.short_comment: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Friday that he plans on starting Daniels in Week 6 against Pittsburgh, Scott Smith reports.

injuries.name: Baker Mayfield
injuries.short_comment: Head coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Mayfield (thumb) is now in a smaller splint, and the Bucs will see if he can progress to gripping the football next week, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times rep

injuries.name: Kenny Gainwell
injuries.short_comment: Gainwell rushed four times for 18 yards and brought in three of four targets for 10 yards in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday night.

injuries.name: Chase McLaughlin
injuries.short_comment: McLaughlin made his only field-goal attempt and all three extra-point tries Thursday in a 24-16 win against Dallas.

injuries.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
injuries.short_comment: Godwin secured all three targets for 37 yards and rushed once for three yards in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday night.

injuries.name: Emeka Egbuka

injuries.name: Bucky Irving

injuries.name: Anthony Hill Jr.
